UPDATE public.service_catalog
SET image_filename      = NULL,
    image_mimetype      = NULL,
    image_drive_file_id = NULL,
    image_web_view_link = NULL,
    image_updated_at    = NULL
WHERE id = $1::integer
RETURNING id::text AS id,
          image_drive_file_id AS previous_drive_file_id

meta.notes:
CONFIGURACIÓN REQUERIDA:
1. Credencial 'Postgres' (POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_ID).
2. Credencial 'Google Drive' (GOOGLE_DRIVE_CREDENTIAL_ID).
3. Webhook CON autenticación Bearer.

RUTA: POST https://<tu-n8n>/webhook/services/image/delete
REQUEST: { "service_id": 48 }
RESPONSE 200: { "success": true, "service_id": "48" }

REQUISITOS: database/scripts/122_20260930_service-booking-and-images.sql
CONTRATO:   src/constants/routes.ts → SERVICE_IMAGE_DELETE
CONSUMIDOR: src/components/services/service-image-uploader.tsx
